categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Hongteo Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of precision aluminum alloy die-casting parts and assemblies for mid-to-high-end automotive engines, transmissions, chassis, and new energy vehicle components. The company focuses on high-technology content products such as engine and transmission precision die-casting parts and new energy vehicle structural components. It also has metal product manufacturing and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in precision aluminum alloy die-casting technology, including advanced mold design and manufacturing, die-casting processes, machining, and inspection methods. It employs international standards such as APQP for product development and uses advanced equipment like fully automatic die-casting machines and high-precision inspection instruments (CT scanners, X-ray flaw detectors, spectrometers, coordinate measuring machines). The company also invests in R&D for new materials, high-pressure casting, heat treatment, and embedded casting processes for new energy vehicle parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hongteo serves major domestic and international automotive manufacturers including Ford, Mercedes-Benz, GAC Group, Geely, Changan, Volvo, XPeng, and others. It also collaborates with automotive parts suppliers like TDK, Valeo, CATL, and Hitachi Astemo. The company’s products cater to traditional internal combustion engine vehicles and rapidly growing new energy vehicle markets. Its customer base includes OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the automotive industry.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases in Guangdong Province (Zhaoqing and Taishan) and has expanded internationally with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Thailand. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets and overseas markets, with significant exports to the United States and other regions including Europe and Japan. The company is actively developing overseas production capacity to mitigate trade risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hongteo operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 supplier specializing in precision aluminum alloy die-casting parts and assemblies. It supplies critical components directly to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 integrators, focusing on engine, transmission, chassis, and new energy vehicle parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on maintaining leadership in precision aluminum alloy die-casting technology, expanding new energy vehicle component development, and enhancing product and business structure balance. R&D priorities include high-performance aluminum alloy components, lightweight and corrosion-resistant casting processes, embedded casting for electric drive housings, and high-precision machining. The company emphasizes rapid product development cycles, project management excellence, and talent cultivation to support innovation and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of precision aluminum alloy die-casting automotive parts and assemblies. The company uses a direct sales model to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 customers. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with export sales recognized based on various international trade terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hongteo is positioned as a leading precision aluminum alloy die-casting supplier in the automotive industry, recognized for its technological innovation and quality. It competes with other automotive die-casting manufacturers domestically and internationally. The company holds a strong market position with long-term contracts with major global OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by numerous industry awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hongteo reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.73 billion, a 1.85% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.82 million, up 79.55%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.12 billion with steady growth in net assets. It maintains positive operating cash flow and invests significantly in R&D (about 3.78% of revenue). The company has expanded its consolidation scope with new subsidiaries, reflecting growth and internationalization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hongteo emphasizes its specialized focus on high-technology, high-precision aluminum alloy die-casting parts for automotive engines, transmissions, and new energy vehicles. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced manufacturing technology, strong R&D capabilities, rapid product development, and stringent quality control systems certified by ISO/TS16949. The company’s strategic location in Guangdong provides supply chain advantages, and its long-term partnerships with leading OEMs and suppliers underscore its reliability and product excellence.
